response.justification: The candidate meets the minimum bar with a BSc in Computer Science and roughly 18 years of hands-on software engineering across web, backend, mobile, and embedded systems, plus entrepreneurial experience as a founder and recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP tooling). However, his career trajectory is that of a strong senior/staff individual contributor rather than a director-level principal engineer; there is no evidence of recognized AI expertise, shipped AI products at scale, organization-wide technical strategy, or advising strategic customers, which are central to this role.
strengths: 18+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across many stacks and domains
Genuine entrepreneurial track record (founder of GISCollective, open-source contributions, workshops and conference talks)
Recent relevant work on AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic developer tooling
concerns: No demonstrated recognized AI/ML expertise or AI-powered products with meaningful scale or visibility
Career history reflects senior/staff IC scope, not the director-level strategic and advisory leadership required
No advanced degree in an AI-related field and limited evidence of deep cloud platform strategy work

key_factors.factor: Lack of recognized AI expertise and AI product track record
Seniority gap versus director-level strategic scope
Long, versatile engineering experience with entrepreneurial background
